critical_code_review_comments: DemoBanner uses fixed top-[82px]/lg:top-[86px]; if the header height ever changes, this literal offset must be updated. Consider computing header height dynamically or using a shared CSS variable to avoid future drift.

Meta.jsx mutates <head> via useEffect only — first paint briefly shows index.html defaults before the effect swaps robots/canonical. For a purely static demo this is harmless (crawlers still see the index.html defaults, which are already noindex-safe), but consider setting the demo defaults directly in public/index.html to be extra safe. (Not blocking — robots.txt already disallows all.)
